originality.rationale: A complete primary-text comparison with Dejter 2010 acknowledges the already-known Coxeter-to-Klein graph construction, while confirming its proofs do not classify maximum induced matchings or their exchange graph. Joos et al. 2013 gives only a general cubic lower bound. Six actual specific research-record searches plus targeted public searches and accessible own claims do not yield the theorem or a stronger covering theorem. Residual unindexed terminology risk remains; lack of search hits is not treated as uniqueness proof.
